rust_summary: a permission node as the mods set it, three-valued (`native_player_permission_value`).
doc_summary: `native_player_permission_value(player, node)` gives a permission node as the permissions mods set it: Some(true), Some(false), or None when none sets it (Bukkit's `isPermissionSet` against `hasPermission`), so a mod applies its own default and parent nodes; the operator level is `native_player_permission`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:permission_value@.
